## Brazil business tour with a conference in Rio

We arrange a business travel programme in [Brazil](/brazil/) that combines a conference in Rio with a trip to four destinations across the country. Start in [São Paulo](/brazil/place/sao-paulo/), travel to [Iguaçu](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/), spend a night at a lodge in the [Amazon](/brazil/place/manaus-amazon/), and continue to [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/).

In Rio, we arrange transfers to the conference at Windsor Oceânico, a shopping trip, and evenings out at restaurants. For participants with a free day, we offer a tour of Corcovado and Sugarloaf Mountain. We’ll work with you on schedules for delegates and accompanying guests so each group has a programme that suits them.

## Request a programme for your team

Send us your dates, group size, conference schedule, and ideas for travel before or after your meetings. We’ll plan the itinerary, select transport, coordinate assistance and meals, and put together a quote for your group.
